note: Antinkatu 24 (1991), street front measured on the rectified Street View image (Antinkatu 24 pano, 18.11.2026): grey concrete, 7.5 m bays between pilasters, each bay big window / small window over a white panel / white fin / small / big on four office floors, a mullioned band on the first floor, shop glazing and a tile band at street level, the Scandic corner with tile panels
Antinkatu 23 b (1964): one-storey shops, white sheet-panel band above (no windows), green awnings; east front measured on the rectified SV (Antinkatu 23 pano, 18.11.2026)
Hacklinin kulma, Mikonkatu 7 / Antinkatu (1920): white render, two shop windows under black awnings, a row of five small attic windows, measured on the rectified SV (18.11.2026)

Antinkatu 23 a (1964) tower: south end bare brown-orange brick with one small window column; street (east) front: a brick strip at the south corner, then recessed glazed balconies behind beige parapet bands on six floors (SV Antinkatu 23 pano, rectified, 18.11.2026; the lowest storeys are hidden behind 126)

Antinkatu 20: grey render with punched windows between two stacks of teal glass balconies, dark stone ground floor with brown wood entrance recesses (SV Antinkatu 20 pano, two rectified views agree, 18.11.2026)

Antinkatu 18 / Liisankatu 8 (1962): white ribbed panels with ochre bands under the windows on six floors, wide and narrow windows in 4.6 m modules, a projecting middle bay over the entrance, shops with a green fascia (SV Antinkatu 18 pano, rectified, 18.11.2026). The first 24 m of the shell's street wall are the lower neighbour, left as it was.

Antinkatu 21 b (Alvar Rahikka 1970): ribbon front - beige parapet bands and continuous glazing on six floors, the ribbons cut in three by white mullions, a shop floor (SV Antinkatu 18 pano, rectified, 18.11.2026). Drawn as a stretch of 135's LoD2 shell.

Antinkatu 19 (Supermarket block): grey render on five floors over a dark shop floor and sign band; balcony stacks - a glazed one at the south end, three open ones with glass parapets between white side fins; window columns measured on rectified SV from two panos (N07 and the Antinkatu 14 pano, whose pose was 5.1 m off along the street: corrected so the shared window columns agree). The north 12 m are seen only at a grazing angle: plain wall.

Teljäntori, Antinkatu front (OSM footprint wall): concrete piers every 8.4 m, shop glazing, a glazed first floor, a dark recessed band and two ribbon storeys of paired windows above (SV Antinkatu 16 pano, rectified, 18.11.2026). The steel-tube canopy of the gallery is not modelled.

Ratsula, Antinkatu 17 (1971), street front measured on the rectified SV (Antinkatu 14 pano, 18.11.2026): red sheet-metal panels above a 4 m glass band with mullions every 2.75 m, a red fascia, the shop floor set 1.4 m back behind red piers every 7.65 m. The first 3.5 m of the LoD2 wall show no red front in the photo (left plain).

Antinkatu 14, Kansankulma (1954): grey render, 2.5 m windows in groups (2, 4, 4, 2) with pairs of small stair windows between them on four floors, a first floor of wide windows at the north end and a row of small ones, a dark stone shop floor with awnings (SV Antinkatu 14 and 17 panos, rectified, 18.11.2026; the two panos disagree by ~4 % in scale, fitted to the LoD2 wall 0-57.9 m)

Itäpuisto 7 / Eteläkauppatori 4b (1979) on the Antinkatu corner: west gable with a painted mural and a blue name sign (drawn as plain colour fields, the artwork is not copied); south front of exposed-aggregate panels, eleven bays between pilasters with three-pane windows on five floors over shops (SV Antinkatu 12 pano and an Itäpuisto photosphere, 18.11.2026; the photosphere's pose is loose, bays spread evenly over the LoD2 wall)

Antinkatu 15 / Itäpuisto 9, funkis block with a rounded south-east corner: rough grey-beige render, four-pane windows on five floors (4 on Antinkatu, 5 on Itäpuisto), green ribbed balconies at the corner, a granite ground floor with the Taito shop under a striped awning, entrance 15 C (SV Antinkatu 12 and Itäpuisto 9 panos, rectified, 18.11.2026; the footprint has a chamfer where the house is round)

Antinkatu 15 A-B, Kehityksen talo (1939): warm grey-brown render, four floors of two-light windows (1.8 x 1.65 m, ~3.3 m apart) on thin dark sill ledges, a column of green-framed triple windows over the gateway 'Antinkatu 15', a projecting bay window at the north end, a red-brown granite shop floor with a dark green glass fascia, door 15 A, a white vertical sign (SV Antinkatu 15 pano, rectified, 18.11.2026; the pano reads the front 43.1 m long, fitted to the footprint edge 0-41.0 m)

Antinkatu 12 (beside 564): two-storey 1960s concrete shop building, not the yellow 'Cafe Anton' of the old note: grey panel walls, a dark glazed shop floor under a thin canopy edge, six three-pane window groups on the upper floor (4.43 m bays), panel joints, blank north end with a door (SV Antinkatu 12 and 15 panos, rectified, 18.11.2026; the front reads 26.9 m, fitted to the footprint edge, 27.6 m up to 564)

Antinkatu 13, Liikekulma (1960): light grey terrazzo, six floors of window bands in 3.6 m bays (two-light window, narrow light, dark grey panel), a dark stone band under the first floor, shop glazing with teal frames all along the street, the drive-through gate B, barber's and bakery signs (SV Antinkatu 12 pano, rectified, 18.11.2026; footprint edge 50.9 m)

Antinkatu 11 (ent. PYP, 1956): white concrete raster of 10 bays x 2.22 m, six floors of two-light windows over blue-grey mosaic panels, a column of recessed loggias in the 9th bay, beige fascia band, Beer Hunter's green awning, shopfronts below (SV Antinkatu pano, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Antinkatu 9: grey-beige render, seven floors of four three-light windows; north of the joint the ROSSO letters, the round concrete balcony, two-light windows above, a two-storey glazed strip and the dark blue corner column; restaurant glazing under red awnings (SV Antinkatu 10 panos, rectified, 19.11.2026; the real front is 22.4 m on a 21.0 m footprint edge: south part compressed 0.915)

Antinkatu 9, the 3.8 m strip that reaches the street north of 1490 (Cafe Anton / office signs): dark glazed entrance, a two-storey glazed bay 1 m out, grey render above with the stacked signs (drawn as plain coloured bars), on the north side over the gateway a stack of glazed balconies (SV Antinkatu 10 panos, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Antinkatu 8, one-storey restaurant: grey-green render piers, four dark shop windows with gridded top lights, a recessed entrance with a folding gate, a dark awning box, green sheet-metal mansard with three round-windowed dormers (SV Antinkatu 9 panos, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Antinkatu 10, two-storey shop wing: beige small-tile piers and bands, four bays of three-light windows over brown spandrels, a rough-render bay with one window over the yard gateway at the north end, shops with red signs (SV Antinkatu 11 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; eaves 6.7 m)

Antinkatu 21a (1979), corner of Liisankatu: two-storey concrete building, upper floor carried over a set-back glazed street floor; precast eave band with ribbed relief panels, window ribbon, red / orange sign fascia (SV Antinkatu 21 and Liisankatu 10 panos, rectified, 19.11.2026; built on the footprint, eave 7.7 m)

Antinkatu 26 / Itsenäisyydenkatu 52: white render, shops + 3 storeys, gable to Antinkatu with a glazed corner balcony stack; Itsenäisyydenkatu: stair glazing over the entrance, yellow panels at two window columns, grey base (SV panos, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Antinkatu 22, six-storey flats in cream brick: window columns with white panels, two stacks of glazed balconies, the south one over the gateway; grey plinth (SV Antinkatu 22 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Antinkatu 20, one-storey yellow timber house on a 1.7 m rendered plinth: six tall two-light windows in white casings, frieze with four attic windows, no door on Antinkatu (SV Antinkatu 22 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Itsenäisyydenkatu 41, two-storey roughcast shop building: dark-framed windows, three shop windows, two doors, red sign (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 41 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; eave 6.8 m under the scan's 8.5 m)

Antinlinna (1929), Itsenäisyydenkatu front: cream-ochre render, eight window axes in brown two-storey surrounds with balustrade and ornament panels, granite main portal with two columns and an attic block, side portal, two shop windows (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 41 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026)

Palojoenkulma (1988), Itsenäisyydenkatu 39: tan brick, seven modules between brick piers - street-floor window band, projecting dark glazed bay, wide window row, four rows of paired ribbon windows (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 39 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; module measured at s 19-34 and repeated)

Yrjönkatu 25 (1927), Itsenäisyydenkatu end: grey-beige render, profiled cornice, three six-pane windows upstairs, two shop windows and a panelled double door with steps (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 46 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; west axis by symmetry)

Itsenäisyydenkatu 54 (1956): yellow roughcast, three storeys of white-framed windows with pebble panels, brick plinth, stair bay with green balcony fronts (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 54 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; the four east axes are mirrored, not seen)

Itsenäisyydenkatu 47: pale ochre render, three storeys, four axes of white six-pane windows, central door in a red granite surround with hood and steps, red granite plinth with cellar windows (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 47 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; the cellar window of the west axis not seen, left out)

Itsenäisyydenkatu 58, south end: grey-beige roughcast, two axes of wide dark-framed windows on seven storeys, glazed corner balcony stacks, glazed shop floor between piers under a canopy band, red-brown board band under dark eaves (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 58 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026). West face (Eteläpuisto 20): eight window axes with grey panels, a projecting glazed balcony stack, recessed shop floor behind piers from s 12.5, windows and plinth north of it (SV Eteläpuisto 19 and 20 panos; s < 4.5 not seen, left plain). Street level recessed on both faces; yard sides not measured

Itsenäisyydenkatu 45, parking house: light grey concrete panels, low wall between two stair towers, grey-blue door, sectional door, open drive-in under blank yellow signs (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 45 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026). Mikonkatu end: open exit, glazed door, sectional door (SV Mikonkatu 10 pano, scale not calibrated). Long sides not measured

Former bus station (1955), Itsenäisyydenkatu end: ochre-beige render, three large white-framed windows, a louvred long window upstairs, dark slate plinth (SV Itsenäisyydenkatu 44 pano, rectified, 19.11.2026; other sides not measured)
